title: Enchanted Ballet Stage
description: A ballerina in a pink tutu dances on one leg while a man in armor holds her waist and a ghostly blue figure projects light from a large movie camera. In the foreground an open book labeled DESPAIR lies on the floor with a sword through it next to a second fallen ballerina and scattered film reels. The scene is a dark theatrical stage with heavy curtains icicles and colored stage lights.
prompt: A ballerina in a pink tutu dances on one leg as a man in green armor holds her waist and a translucent blue ghost projects beams of light from a large vintage movie camera. In the foreground an open book with the word DESPAIR lies on the floor with a sword through it next to a second fallen ballerina in a pink tutu and scattered film reels. The setting is a dark theatrical stage with heavy curtains icicles colored stage lights and hanging film reels. Dark fantasy style with dramatic lighting and rich colors.
